periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, with the primary axis angled approximately 45 to 60 degrees downward toward the snout relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval morphology; the height of the patch is significantly greater than its width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering where the patch extends into a teardrop-like point well below the medial horizontal axis of the eye.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior boundary with a relatively flat curve across the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, occupying approximately 30-35% of the visible upper torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, with the gap between the inner margins of the ears roughly equal to 1.2 times the width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semi-circular curvature at the superior margins with no visible flattening.
